title: 第七章黄庭丹第八章台海宗第九章交易
slug: 凡人修仙我能变废为宝
lines: 三天后的中午，江离脸上难掩喜色。
敛气诀，被他修成了！
也就是说，之后再也不需要考虑修炼速度过快的问题。
心中的一块石头落地，江离倍感轻松。
推开门，深呼吸立刻一口新鲜空气，便向着炼丹房的方向走去。
这几日，他的大部分时间都用在了修炼敛气诀上，很少出门。
虽说这段时间没人来炼丹，但日常巡视维护还是要做的。
而且今天还是领取黄庭丹的日子，等巡视完丹房，便去杂役班房走上一趟。
还没等他走到炼丹房，便看到了宋展的身影。
本来宋展说的是，今天傍晚时分才会回来，没想到竟提前了。
见到江离，宋展显得极为热情。
“江师弟，过来过来，我跟你讲讲。”
宋展一看到江离，便热情的招呼他过去。
“我跟你讲，咱们修仙界出大事了。”
“这两天我出去办事，听到了一个消息。台海宗一夜之间，把断弥山给灭了。”
江离听的一脸懵逼。
台海宗？
断弥山？
那是什么东西？
试探性问道：“这是两个修仙宗门吗？”
被江离这么一问，宋展反而一脸不可置信的样子。
“你不知道断弥山就算了，你居然连台海宗都不知道。”
江离不好意思的傻笑一下。
他还确实不知道。
虽说江离一心想着修仙，但关于修仙界的事，可以说几乎是一片空白。
甚至其中大部分事，还是从宋展那听来的。
一下子，宋展被江离搞得也没了脾气，只好耐心解释道：“断弥山倒是没什么好讲的，和咱们小月宗一样，只是一个小门小派。但台海宗就不同了，这可是咱们沧澜州最大的修仙宗门，没有之一。比咱们小月宗不知道大了多少。”
“我继续跟你讲。”
“据台海宗的说法，断弥山盗窃了台海宗的修仙功法。”
江离忍不住说道：“这不太可能吧？按照你的说法，断弥山哪来的胆子敢这么做。”
宋展耸耸肩，他也不太相信这种说法。
“外界对此也有诸多猜测，有人说是断弥山得了某样天材地宝被台海宗惦记上了。也有人说是断弥山的某弟子调戏了台海宗的一名女弟子，那名女弟子正好与台海宗某位实权长老有着不可告人的关系。还有人说是……”
content_en:
At noon three days later, Jiang Li couldn't hide the joy on his face.
The Qi Condensing Technique was mastered by him!
In other words, there is no need to consider the problem of practicing too fast in the future.
A stone fell from his heart, and Jiang Li felt relieved.
He opened the door, took a deep breath and immediately walked towards the alchemy room.
In the past few days, he spent most of his time practicing the Qi Condensation Technique and rarely went out.
Although no one came to make alchemy during this period, daily inspection and maintenance still need to be done.
And today is the day to receive Huang Tingdan. After inspecting the elixir room, he will go to the handyman's room.
Before he reached the alchemy room, he saw Song Zhan's figure.
Originally, Song Zhan said he would come back this evening, but unexpectedly it was earlier than expected.
Seeing Jiang Li, Song Zhan looked extremely enthusiastic.
"Junior Brother Jiang, come here, let me talk to you."
As soon as Song Zhan saw Jiang Li, he warmly greeted him over.
"I'm telling you, something big has happened in our world of immortality."
"I have been out on business for the past two days and I heard a piece of news. The Taihaizong destroyed Duanmi Mountain overnight."
Jiang Li was confused when he heard this.
Taiwan Hai Zong?
Duanmi Mountain?
What is that?
He asked tentatively: "Are these two immortal cultivating sects?"
When asked by Jiang Li, Song Zhan looked in disbelief.
"It doesn't matter if you don't know Duan Mishan, you actually don't even know about Taihaizong."
Jiang Li smiled sheepishly.
He really doesn't know yet.
Although Jiang Li only thinks about cultivating immortals, it can be said that he is almost blank about the world of cultivating immortals.
Even most of these things were heard from Song Zhan.
Suddenly, Song Zhan lost his temper due to Jiang Li, and had to patiently explain: "Duan Mi Mountain doesn't have much to say. Just like our Xiaoyue Sect, it is just a small sect. But Taihai Sect is different. This is the largest immortal cultivating sect in Canglan Prefecture. It is much bigger than our Xiaoyue Sect."
"I'll keep telling you."
"According to Taihaizong, Duan Mishan stole Taihaizong's immortality cultivation technique."
Jiang Li couldn't help but said, "Isn't this impossible? According to you, how dare Duan Mishan dare to do this."
Song Zhan shrugged. He didn't quite believe this statement.
"There are also many speculations about this from the outside world. Some people say that Duan Mi Mountain obtained some kind of heavenly material and earthly treasure and was noticed by the Taihai Sect. Some people say that a disciple of Duan Mi Mountain molested a female disciple of the Taihai Sect, and that female disciple happened to have an ulterior relationship with a powerful elder of the Taihai Sect. Others said..."
